mapper.select: SELECT i.id order_item_id,i.product_id FROM order_items i JOIN shop_orders o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE i.id=#{itemId} AND o.customer_id=#{customerId} AND o.status IN ('RECEIVED','COMPLETED')
SELECT r.*,CONCAT(u.first_name,' ',u.last_name) reviewer_name FROM product_reviews r JOIN app_users u ON u.id=r.customer_id WHERE r.order_item_id=#{itemId}
SELECT r.*,CONCAT(u.first_name,' ',u.last_name) reviewer_name FROM product_reviews r JOIN app_users u ON u.id=r.customer_id WHERE r.product_id=#{productId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(rating),0) FROM product_reviews WHERE product_id=#{productId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_reviews WHERE product_id=#{productId}
